payload.question: You get a text message: 'Your USPS package is held due to an incomplete address. Update delivery details: usps-delivery-update.net/redeliver' You are expecting a package. What do you do?
options: Go directly to usps.com and enter your tracking number there to check the status
Click the link since you are expecting a package and it could be legitimate
Reply STOP to opt out of the messages
Google the tracking number from the text

explanation: This is smishing (SMS phishing). The domain 'usps-delivery-update.net' is not USPS's real domain (usps.com). Attackers send these in bulk knowing a percentage of recipients will be expecting packages. The link leads to a fake site that steals credit card info under the guise of a 'redelivery fee.' Always go to the official website directly — never click tracking links in texts.
